title: agent-array / Platform
description: ARC runner pods by pool, restic backup status, sealed-secrets and Argo CD application health.

panels.title: Runner pods running
panels.description: arc-light runs in namespace arc-runners (max 10), arc-heavy in arc-heavy (max 3).

panels.title: Listener ready
panels.description: One AutoscalingListener pod per scale set in arc-systems. ARCListenerDown is critical after 10m.

panels.title: Runner pods on the control plane
panels.description: CI pods scheduled on $node. Expected to be 0 once runners move to $node (factory design M3).

targets.expr: count(kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"arc-runners|arc-heavy"} * on (node) group_left () max by (node) (kube_node_role{job="kube-state-metrics", role="control-plane"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Runner pods by pool and phase

targets.expr: label_replace(count by (node) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace=~"arc-runners|arc-heavy"}), "host", "$1", "node", "(.+)") and on (node) kube_node_info{node=~"$node"}

panels.title: Runner CPU by pool
panels.description: CPU cores used by runner containers (runner and dind).

panels.title: Jobs and runners (ARC listener metrics)
panels.description: Listener metrics are off today: set metrics.* in the gha-runner-scale-set-controller values and apply monitoring/alerts/pending/arc.podmonitor.yaml. Until then this panel is empty.

panels.title: Since last successful backup
panels.description: Daily timer. AgentArrayBackupStale is critical after 36h.

panels.title: Since last passing restic check
panels.description: Weekly restic check. AgentArrayBackupCheckFailing warns after 8 days.

panels.title: Sealing keys
panels.description: The controller adds a key every 30 days; old keys stay so old seals still decrypt.

panels.title: Apps by health
panels.description: Manual-sync apps that are not deployed yet show as Missing; that is expected.

targets.expr: max by (name, project, dest_namespace, health_status, sync_status, autosync_enabled) (argocd_app_info)
